observations.body: The place the LORD chooses is repeated against sacrifice within local gates.
observations.label: Place

observations.body: Night departure, haste, bread of affliction, no yeast, and nothing left overnight carry the remembered event.
observations.label: Memory and food

observations.body: The worshiper arrives, sacrifices at evening, eats, returns to tents in the morning, and reaches a seventh-day assembly.
observations.label: Movement
